blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Every day at Czarnikow looks similar. We arrive, we check our emails, we have meetings, and we go home. It is a simple routine, and everyone follows it.

To describe a routine in English, we use the Present Simple. It is the most common tense of all. We say "I arrive at 9am", "I check my emails", "We start the day at 9", and "I leave the office at 6pm".

Today you learn five important words: arrive, check, start, finish, and leave. We go step by step. English comes in CAN's, not in CAN'Ts. You can do it!

items.q: Which tense do we use to describe a daily routine?
items.why: "To describe a routine in English, we use the Present Simple."

items.q: How many new words do you learn today?
items.why: "Today you learn five important words: arrive, check, start, finish, and leave."

items.q: What do people do first when they arrive?
items.why: "We arrive, we check our emails, we have meetings…" — checar emails vem logo depois de chegar.

items.q: The text says "English comes in CAN's, not in CAN'Ts." This suggests that the author wants you to feel…
items.why: Inferência: a frase é de incentivo — o autor quer que você se sinta capaz e confiante.

items.q: The author would most likely AGREE that learning English is…
options: possible, one step at a time
items.why: Inferência: "We go step by step… You can do it!" — o autor vê o aprendizado como possível, passo a passo.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Sophie falar sobre o dia dela na Czarnikow. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hello! My name is Sophie, and I work at Czarnikow. Let me tell you about my typical day.

I arrive at the office at nine o'clock. First, I check my emails. Then we start the day at nine. I work with the HR team, and I like my job very much.

At ten o'clock, I have a meeting with my team. We talk about our plans for the week. At one o'clock, I have lunch. I usually eat with my friends from the office.

In the afternoon, I check my emails again and I answer many messages. I finish my work at six o'clock. Then I leave the office and I go home by train.

Every day is very similar, but I am happy. Every day is a new chance to learn and to do good work. See you tomorrow!
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What time does Sophie arrive at the office?
items.why: "I arrive at the office at nine o'clock."

items.q: Which team does Sophie work with?
items.why: "I work with the HR team."

items.q: How does Sophie go home?
items.why: "I leave the office and I go home by train."

items.q: Sophie says "Every day is a new chance." This suggests that she…
items.why: Inferência: apesar da rotina parecida, ela se sente feliz — é uma atitude positiva.

items.q: From what Sophie says, how does she feel about her job?
items.why: Inferência: "I like my job very much" e "I am happy" mostram que ela gosta do trabalho.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "I arrive at work at 9am." To arrive means to…
items.why: Arrive = chegar a um lugar.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Every morning I ___ my emails before the meeting."
items.why: Check = checar/verificar — verificar os emails.

items.q: "We start the day at nine." To start means to…
items.why: Start = começar.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "I ___ my work at six and then I go home."
items.why: Finish = terminar — termino o trabalho às seis.

items.q: "I leave the office at 6pm." To leave means to…
items.why: Leave = sair / deixar um lugar.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples do dia a dia no trabalho. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "I get to work at nine." To get to work means to…
items.why: Get to work = chegar ao trabalho.

items.q: "Let's start off with the emails." To start off means to…
items.why: Start off = começar (dar início).

items.q: "I go over my emails every morning." To go over means to…
items.why: Go over = revisar / checar com atenção.

items.q: "We wrap up the day at six." To wrap up means to…
items.why: Wrap up = finalizar, encerrar.

items.q: "At six I head home by train." To head home means to…
items.why: Head home = ir para casa.
